versions.changelog:
- Initial release of codex-export-more.
- Export Codex CLI or Desktop sessions to Markdown, HTML, or Obsidian notes.
- Supports advanced options: brief mode, redaction, time-range filtering, message grep, incremental export, interactive message picker, session merging, and auto-incremental watch mode.
- Automatically strips system messages, injected context, and deduplicates by message ID.
- Compatible with both CLI and desktop session formats, with configurable session home directory.
